summary.text: Bill Roop, listed by Ballotpedia as Carl Roop, is a Republican attorney and member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 44 who is seeking re-election against Democrat Christina Baisden in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was appointed to the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Bill Roop's career experience includes working as an attorney.
Governor Jim Justice appointed Roop to the House of Delegates on July 16, 2024, to replace Todd Kirby, and he assumed office on August 2, 2024.
